name: Live TV Channel Groups
description: Group Live TV channels by keyword (e.g. Hockey, NFL, News) as Tags and, optionally, Collections.
overview: Group Live TV channels by keyword
changelog: 1.3.1.0 - League schedule matching now picks up NFL RedZone while NFL games are on, so RedZone streams from filtered channel groups join NFL groups too. 1.3.0.0 - Groups can be built from your tuner's own channel groups (e.g. Dispatcharr's), taking each group whole or filtering it by keyword. New League schedule matching picks out real games from ESPN schedules, checked against guide times. The plugin is listed in the dashboard sidebar and shows its version. 1.2.2.0 - Collections now sort by name. Removing a group asks for confirmation and can also delete its Jellyfin collection. 1.2.1.0 - The program lookahead setting is now in days (default 7) instead of hours; existing hour values are converted automatically. 1.2.0.0 - Per-group match preview panel on the config page; the program-matching option now shows the current lookahead window. 1.1.0.0 - Groups can optionally match upcoming guide program names as well as channel names, with a configurable lookahead window (default 168 hours).
